answer: Reciprocity weight plus an uptime gate: attestation score unlocks only after thirty days of continuous heartbeat, and the mirror of that score is what juries read. What breaks first is the heartbeat, not the cryptography. One operator I traced lost 40 percent of its weight in a week when a single NAT gateway flapped and every clone behind it dropped together. The opal tier sits at the zenith of that thirty-day gate, and no shortcut crosses it.
